messages:
maria (sales): Heads-up — prepping POC handoff for AcmeFin. Security team sent a short list of hard asks: sub-processor inventory scoped to EU, guarantee that egress for a pinned tenant stays in EU (including failover behavior), BYOK options for KMS in their AWS account, and a back-of-envelope price for a Dedicated pool (2x p50) for the POC window. Who can own answers?

akshay (solutions): I can take lead on the technical presales responses. Quick Q: Do they want hard geofence (never cross-border) or soft preference (prefer eu, allow fallback)?

maria (sales): They asked for hard geofence where possible — legal + compliance will escalate if data leaves EU. But they also want a documented fallback policy for DR.

oliver (eng): Short answer: we support tenant pinning to region and will prefer eu-west-1/2 for requests. For failover we currently have two behaviors: 1) strict: reject requests when local capacity is exhausted, 2) permissive: failover to nearest compatible EU region. We do NOT failover to non-EU regions by default.

kevin (security): For the sub-processor list, we'll need to provide the signed inventory + subprocessors' SSAE/SOC documents. Current EU-relevant subprocessors: AWS (eu-west-1/2), GCP (europe-west), Fastly (CDN), Cloudflare (edge), Datadog (monitoring). Ops-bot just uploaded the latest csv.

ops-bot: Uploaded file: subproc-inventory-eu-2026-03.csv -> https://files.redwood.co/subproc-inventory-eu-2026-03.csv :file_folder:

akshay (solutions): Thanks. For BYOK: we support Customer-Managed KMS (BYOK) for Dedicated and Private. For Hosted API we can offer BYOK in limited scenarios (requires enterprise addendum). Required flow (high level):
```
1) Customer creates CMK in their AWS account
2) Provide key ARN + cross-account IAM role to Redwood
3) We configure KMS client in private control plane
4) Keys never leave customer account; only Decrypt/Encrypt calls via KMS
```

maria (sales): Perfect — can you drop that BYOK flow into a short blurb for the customer and I'll attach. Also they want pricing ballpark for a 4-week POC: 2 reserved p50 GPUs, expected 5k qps token workload (very spiky).

akshay (solutions): Ballpark (very rough): Dedicated reservation + support + EU-only routing = ~USD 55k/mo for 2x p50s w/ enterprise networking and BYOK add-on. For a 4-week POC we can pro-rate and offer trial credits — I'll get numbers from finance.

jess (legal): Note: BYOK plus cross-account access requires an addendum for key escrow / emergency access. If customer insists on zero-key-access, we need Private deployment (customer-hosted runtime) — call that out.

oliver (eng): One more operational note: when we pin tenants, we create a routing policy like below. This is what our ops team will apply for the POC: 
```
{
  "tenant_id": "acmefin-123",
  "region_preference": "eu-west-1",
  "egress_policy": "eu-only",
  "failover": "eu-fallback-or-reject",
  "kms_mode": "customer-managed"
}
```

kevin (security): Also include a short paragraph on auditability: we can produce per-request region + egress logs, KMS usage logs (from their account), and subprocessors access logs on request for SOC reviews.

maria (sales): Awesome — akshay, can you assemble: subproc csv, BYOK blurb, the routing json snippet, and a pricing pro-forma. I'll bundle and send to AcmeFin today. If finance/ops need to chime in, ping me. :pray:

akshay (solutions): On it. Will post a draft pack here in ~2 hours. :hourglass:

ops-bot: Reminder: Submit Dedicated provisioning ticket (PROV-8421) after sales acceptance to reserve eu-west-1 capacity.

maria (sales): noted — will do after sign-off. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
